x: Other very fine performances during the season included Michael Parper's win in the Surrey County senior 400m, while still a junior, in a championship best time; and Philips Idowu's championship best triple jump at the English Schools' meeting.
Then Philips Idowu withdrew from the triple jump after 3 attempts due to a slight injury. His best of 14.81 was probably his poorest competition of the year and only good enough for 7th spot.
With the likes of Charles Igbon, Scott Exley, Steve Scott, Samson Oni and Philips Idowu providing major back-up, we were going to be difficult to beat.
This month also saw six of our club members travel to Gothenburg for the European U23 Championships: Dearman again, Philips Idowu, Richard David, Marlon Dickson, Michael Parper and Ben Challenger.

Philips Idowu reported 20 minutes before the triple jump that his back was going into spasm and he couldn't run, let alone jump. Apparently he had seen the same local physio as Brendan Reilly and was now no more!
In the long jump Julian Flynn just pipped Darren Thompson, while in the triple jump our only entry, Philips Idowu, almost made 16m off a short run-up.

In the triple jump, Philips Idowu leapt to 16.11 (no wind speed) and the vaulters achieved a valuable double with Mike Edwards again getting the better of Ben Flint and in so doing moved up the all time points list to fourth spot.
